risks.risk: A phone cannot realistically be designed from scratch by a start-up (modem, RF, OS, certification)
risks.mitigation: ODM reference platform with pre-certified modem; customise enclosure, colours, display, sensors and software

risks.risk: Carrier certification and OS licensing (Google Mobile Services / AOSP) gate the launch
risks.mitigation: Pick the ODM platform already certified on the target carriers; AOSP-based launcher for the 'no social apps' experience

risks.risk: Software updates and security patches for years
risks.mitigation: Contract the ODM for a patch schedule (e.g. 3 years) with the BSP

risks.risk: SAR re-test when the antenna area or back material changes
risks.mitigation: Keep the ODM's antenna layout; metal back → budget a SAR + OTA re-test

build_strategy.title: ODM customisation
build_strategy.explanation: Not designed from scratch. Products like this need a modem / optics / autonomy stack and years of certification work, so the realistic path is an ODM (original design manufacturer) with a close reference platform: you customise the enclosure, colours, display, sensors and software, and the ODM builds it on its certified base.
customisable: Display size / type from the ODM's options
Sensors and camera modules from the ODM's options
Software: launcher, app policy (e.g. no social apps), UI

entry_cost.label: estimate
entry_cost.source_or_assumption: Typical first production run for this category (ODM NRE for customisation ≈ $250-400k, certifications + carrier ≈ $100k, software ≈ $100k) — industry range, not a quote

lead_time.label: estimate
lead_time.source_or_assumption: Frozen design → first production units (tooling, samples, certification), typical

path: Find an ODM with a close reference platform (size, chipset / modem bands or sensor, price tier) — shortlist 3 and get their reference designs
Customise what differentiates the product: enclosure and CMF (colours, materials, finish), display, sensors, buttons, packaging
Customise the software on the ODM's SDK / BSP (launcher, app policy, UI) and contract the update schedule

Certifications: carried over where the RF / electrical design is unchanged (modular approvals), redone where you change it (new antenna area, metal back, new radio) — plus the product-level declaration in each market
Engineering samples → pilot run (EVT/DVT/PVT) → mass production on the ODM line
build_strategy.certifications_note: Modem and radio approvals carried over only if the RF design is unchanged; SAR, carrier (PTCRB/GCF) and RED/FCC declarations for your model.
